Men's average front depth exceeds women's for every brand shown; the gap ranges from 1.500 cm at Abercrombie to 10.250 cm at Ralph Lauren.

code: measurements.assign(frontDepth=measurements[['maxHeightFront','minHeightFront']].mean(axis=1)).groupby('menWomen').apply(lambda g: pd.Series({'jeans': len(g), 'mean_price': g.price.mean(), 'mean_front_depth_cm': g.frontDepth.mean(), 'price_depth_spearman': g.price.rank().corr(g.frontDepth.rank())}), include_groups=False).round(3)
